WHY: NotReadyError is defined in errors.ts:1 as 'The gateway HAS the charge but has not settled it yet (transient)', so every poll tick on an unsettled charge now creates an additional duplicate charge on the gateway. A related defect: `replace('_', '-')` only replaces the first underscore, so "pt_br_extra" normalizes to "pt-BR_EXTRA" and is rejected as unsupported. HOW: guard the missing segment and normalize the whole string, e.g. `const [language, region] = input.replace(/_/g, '-').split('-'); return region ? `${language.toLowerCase()}-${region.toUpperCase()}` : language.toLowerCase();`
